Motivation and significance
Music discovery can reflect a listener’s expression, cultural context and feedback.
Mathur et al., 2015  ·  Valla et al., 2017
Facial expressions offer a convenient, uncertain input that a user can correct.
Hindustani metadata adds cultural context beyond generic genre labels.
Persistent feedback lets recommendations adapt to individual experience.
Research objective: build and test the full software loop. Therapeutic efficacy remains unestablished.

The new experiment fine-tunes the full emotion feature path, with frozen BN statistics, mild image augmentation, train-only cached self-distillation and EMA. Initialization preserved v2 logits. Candidate selection and flip/temperature calibration used validation only. This run is locked after its one frozen candidate evaluation; validation is repeatedly reused and test is historically inspected. No 80% result is claimed. Historical epoch indices include cheaper frozen-backbone MLP training. The native chart shows every new full-network epoch from this consistency experiment, including rejected epochs, not a selected subset. Training accuracy is for the augmented student with dropout; validation is the logged student/EMA candidate without augmentation. They measure different conditions. The confusion matrix and test summary belong to the active model; the new candidate test comparison is on slide11. Baseline/recipes/negative results are detailed in FURTHER_RESULTS.md. Disgust remains weak and webcam-domain performance unverified. No equal-budget causal architecture ablation. Paper's very high reported accuracies are not reproduced.

Each task has constant game identity and exactly 30-second duration. EEG/cardio/fusion use the same labelled source windows and leave-one-participant-out folds, logistic C=1 class-balanced, scaler fitted only on training participants. QWOP Angry/Happy, CBAAD Bored/Stressed. Duration-only and game-only controls match the majority control. Neither task gains macro F1 from fusion. QWOP paired interval [-0.24019047619047618,0.24455544455544453]; CBAAD [-0.2837301587301587,0.28360177404295045]. Primary subtract-offset convention not independently confirmed; alternate-sign results remain sensitivity, never selected for higher score. Other artifacts/annotation/movement confounds remain. Old pooled emotion/game confounding is historical only. No facial/physiology, disgust, weather or raga joint validation. FDCF paper Eqs10–15: https://doi.org/10.1007/s41870-025-02531-y. Future work and publication possibilities
Publication depends on sound data, rights and evaluation.
Train equal-budget attention / pooling ablations with multiple seeds, stronger split controls and calibrated uncertainty.
Collect consented listening feedback and expert-reviewed raga annotations. Evaluate chronological ranking and IKS ablation.
Resolve physiological source-dimension and timing issues, obtain adequate windows and validate on held-out people and stimulus identities.
A reproducibility or systems paper is plausible after these experiments. Clinical and patent claims require separate substantiation.
No publication acceptance, novelty, clinical efficacy or patentability is promised. Resolve third-party permissions before releasing catalog or checkpoint assets.
